name: Engines of War
text:
Note: Basic siege armies know Engines of War automatically, and must 'spend' their first tactic on it.

---

Siege engines cannot be outfitted with gear. They cannot attack Engaged armies. They are more difficult to destroy due to their higher hit points than other basic armies. A siege engine can attack and damage fortifications with its ranged attacks as part of the Battle or Overwhelming Bombardment actions.
